_about: epic-dod.mjs config for dobby-foundation. `aliases` map how sprint docs name a repo to owner/repo. `bareRefsRepo` is null on purpose: this repo's epics cite the consuming projects too, so a bare #N is ambiguous (`#143` here vs golden-beans#143) and epic-dod IGNORES the knob whenever the alias map names a second repo — cite owner/repo#N or a full PR link. `exemptions` excuse ONE derived item on ONE epic, with a reason; an exemption on an item that now passes is STALE and fails.
